text: I verified the coordinator's claim rather than trusting it: `web/src/routes/` has no `a` directory, and every naddr link-builder targets `/note/<naddr>` (`server/nostr.ts:535`, `artifact-preview.ts:675`, `ndk/artifacts.ts:788`). Changed `CURATION_SET_SHARE_BASE_URL` to **`https://highlighter.com/note/`** and added explicit `/note/` prefix assertions in both the Rust and Swift tests.
